Definition
[Jacobian $J_y\mathbf f$] ↗ def:gradient-matrix-df-rectangular-notation 1. appC:C.6-def-3\group Inverse and Implicit Function Theorems

Set \[ J_y\mathbf f :=|\det D_y\mathbf f| =\left|\frac{\partial (f^1,\ldots ,f^m)}{\partial (y_1,\ldots ,y_m)}\right|. \]
